column1: # The fresh-eyes pass: the same 50 classes and 16 no-answer queries, but the descriptions avoid the class name and its obvious
# synonym, the way a stranger who has not seen the class list would write them. If the floor's behaviour on golden/esc50/queries.tsv
# were an artefact of friendly wording, it would not survive this.
